A Number on a Job Posting Carries More Weight Than You Think For most of the history of Canadian recruitment, salary was a late-stage conversation — disclosed grudgingly, negotiated quietly, and occasionally used as a trap. Post a role, collect applications, evaluate candidates, then reveal compensation somewhere between the second interview and the offer. That era ended on January 1, 2026.
